ModuleName: Generating Module Learning Outcomes with Bloom's Taxonomy

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists all topic headings and subtopics covered in the module — including SLOs, Bloom's Taxonomy levels, and PreseMaker's SLO generation process — giving instructors and learners a structural overview of what the module addresses.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs)
Artifacts.Description: Explains what Student Learning Outcomes are, why they are central to instructional design, and how they function as measurable targets, providing learners with the conceptual foundation needed before working with Bloom's Taxonomy or PreseMaker.

Artifacts.Name: Overview of Bloom's Taxonomy Cognitive Levels
Artifacts.Description: Describes Bloom's Taxonomy's six hierarchical cognitive levels — from Remember through Create — including their origins and revisions, giving learners the framework needed to understand how learning outcomes are categorized by complexity.

Artifacts.Name: How PreseMaker Generates SLOs from Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Explains the step-by-step process PreseMaker uses to convert instructor-supplied module topics into precise, actionable Student Learning Outcomes, helping instructors understand and trust the system's SLO generation logic.

Artifacts.Name: Calibrating Outcomes to Bloom's Taxonomy Levels
Artifacts.Description: Covers how to match learning outcomes to the correct Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive level for a given module's demands, helping instructors ensure their outcomes are neither too basic nor too advanced for the intended learning goals.

Artifacts.Name: Reviewing and Interpreting Generated Learning Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: Guides instructors through reading and interpreting the SLOs PreseMaker generates by explaining the three-part structure — source topic, Bloom's level, and action verb — so they can evaluate whether each outcome accurately reflects instructional intent.

Artifacts.Name: SLOs as the Foundation for Subsequent Content Generation
Artifacts.Description: Explains how approved SLOs serve as the structural backbone that drives all subsequent content generation in PreseMaker, helping instructors understand why reviewing and confirming SLOs is a critical step before proceeding.
